diagnosis: Top-heavy: 44 live tops and 15 live knits over 9 trousers and 6 pairs of shoes. Four of the six live chinos are the same stone/beige family. Spend below the waist.
corrections_to_draft: Mid-grey chino: the closet has 6 live chinos, 4 in the beige-to-stone family — not 'nine chinos and eight of them'.
Navy crew-neck: you already own topman-navy-crew. And a V-neck is what layers over a shirt collar; a crew is the one that fights it. The real gap is a fine gauge, not the neckline.
Rain-safe dark shoe: the Church's derby, the brown Chelsea and the tan brogue are all rain-safe. What collapses on a wet day is the casual end — every casual shoe you own is rain-unsafe.
